thread:
yara: follow-up from today's shard rebalance deep-dive. capturing the tuning playbook + safety knobs we agreed to iterate on.

tom: thanks — biggest control knob is the rebalancer damping factor. if too low we oscillate; too high and hotspots persist. propose default = 0.2 (i.e., move 20% of suggested load per window) with exponential backoff on repeat migrations.

eva: agree. also add per-tenant cooldown: once moved, a tenant is ineligible for migration for N minutes (configurable by tenant class). prevents ping-pong.

liam: we need a clear metric to detect oscillation: migrations/sec over a rolling 1m > M and migrations/backoff ratio > R. ops automation should pause rebalancer when triggered.

yara: action: set M=10 migrations/sec for cluster, R=1.5 (i.e., more migrations than successful rebalances). we'll iterate in canary.

tom: safety mode: two flavors — soft (reduce damping to 0.05 and increase cooldown) and hard (pause migrations entirely and only allow spill tokens). soft mode auto-recovers after stable window; hard mode requires manual ack.

eva: spill tokens are our low-risk mitigation path. reminder: tokens must be signed, TTL short (200-500ms), and include donor_shard, token_capacity, nonce, sig. recipient validates and debits local counters.

liam: telemetry: emit span events for: token-issued, token-consumed, migration-requested, migration-completed, migration-failed, migration-aborted-cooldown. expose these in a migration dashboard and an alert rule.

yara: quota safety: if a tenant hits a legal/billing hard cap, reject at ingress (slow path consult). we must mark these tenants as "must-fail-closed" so rebalancer will never grant provisional admits.

tom: abuse sync: use the central abuse ledger writes + per-shard cache (ttl 2s). add a push channel for "block now" events to reduce enforcement latency for high-risk cases.

eva: testing plan: 1) microbench: synthetic driver with 1000 tenants, varying burst shapes; 2) traffic replay: replay 24h of production 10% sample to staging; 3) chaos: kill shards during rebalancer to validate anti-duplication and lease resolution.

liam: lease resolution: if two shards claim a tenant, consult the lease store generation. losers backoff and demote provisional tokens. lease writes use CAS on metadata store; add metrics for lease-conflicts.

yara: operational runbook snippets: - detect oscillation -> auto-enter soft safety mode. - if oscillation persists 5m -> escalate and pause rebalancer. - if tenant migration fails with data-plane errors -> roll back provisional admits and tag tenant for manual review.

tom: config API needed: cluster.damping, tenant.cooldown, token.ttl_ms, safety.migration_thresholds, slowpath.quota_consult_enabled. expose per-tenant overrides via namespace metadata.

eva: small proto for migration suggestion: {tenant_id, src_shard, dst_shard, suggested_capacity_pct, reason, score}. we'll store suggestions in a bounded queue for auditing.

liam: security: all migration/signing calls require mTLS + shard-id claim. signed tokens rotate keys daily and revoke lists propagated via control plane.

yara: next steps: tom protos the damping/flags and feature toggles, eva writes the test harness + chaos scenarios, liam configures alerts and the migration dashboard. i'll open INFRA-1810 with the checklist. ops-bot: create INFRA-1810 and link. :robot_face:

ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-1810 "rebalance tuning playbook & safety modes" and linked this thread.

tom: thanks — aiming to canary with 5% traffic next sprint.

eva: i'll share harness results before canary.

liam: noted for runbook updates.

yara: thanks all. we'll capture defaults in the RFC addendum and land experiments. :seedling:
